Who were the leaders from the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh?

auws
Who was the leader from the tribe of Benjamin who would stand with Moses and Aaron?

Who was the leader from the tribe of Dan who would stand with Moses and Aaron?

Eliasaph, the son of Deuel, was the leader from the tribe of Gad.

Who was the leader from the tribe of Naphtali who would stand with Moses and Aaron?

What position did the men named in verses 5-15 hold in Israel?
They were the leaders of their tribes, and they led the clans of Israel.
zga8
Which men did Moses and Aaron take?

pxom

How many men of the tribe of Zebulun were counted?

How many men of the tribe of Ephraim were counted?

How many men of the tribe of Manasseh were counted?

How many men of the tribe of Benjamin were counted?

41,500 men of the tribe of Asher were counted.

How many men of the tribe of Naphtali were counted?
53,400 men of the tribe of Naphtali were counted.
vwo0
How many leaders of Israel helped Moses and Aaron count the men?
Twelve leaders helped them, one man for each ancestral family.
s9ns
Which men of Israel were counted according to their ancestral families?
All the men who were 20 years old or older and could go out to war in Israel were counted.
hpk6
How many men 20 years old or older who could go out to war were counted?
There were 603,550 men counted.
svur
Which tribe was not counted with the other tribes?
The Levites were not counted with the other tribes.
e9fb
What did Yahweh tell Moses about the tribe of Levi?
Yahweh told Moses not to count the tribe of Levi among the sons of Israel.
nmm4
What were the Levites assigned to care for?
They were assigned to care for the Dwelling of the Testimony, all its vessels, and everything that belongs to it.
sua8
What would happen to any stranger who came near the Dwelling?
That stranger would be put to death.
lda8
Where were the people of Israel to set up their tents?
Each man was to set up his tent by his own banner, according to his army division.
hqmx
Where were the Levites to set up their tents?
They were to set up their tents around the Dwelling of the Testimony.
g3mt
Did the people do what Yahweh commanded?
Yes, the people of Israel did everything that Yahweh commanded Moses.
wjuh
Where did Yahweh tell Moses and Aaron that the tribes must set up their tents?
Yahweh told them that each tribe must camp near its own banner and the sign of its ancestral family. They must camp around the tent of meeting, at a distance from it.
vrlr
Where did Yahweh say the 74,600 men of the army of the tribe of Judah must camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp near the banner of Judah on the east side of the tent of meeting, where the sun rises, and Nahshon must lead their army.
j6uh
Where must the 54,400 men of the tribe of Issachar camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp next to Judah, and Nethanel must lead their army.
k7z1
Where must the 57,400 men of the tribe of Zebulun camp, and who must lead their army?
They must also camp next to Judah, and Eliab must lead their army.
gnm8
Who must set out first from the camp?
The whole camp of Judah, with the two tribes that set up their tents near Judah tribe, must set out first.
hjgl
Where must the 46,500 men of the tribe of Reuben camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp near the banner of Reuben on the south side of the tent of meeting, and Elizur must lead their army.
mdx9
Where must the 59,300 men of the tribe of Simeon camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp next to Reuben, and Shelumiel must lead their army.
ka0d
Where must the 45,650 men of the tribe of Gad camp, and who must lead their army?
They must also camp next to Reuben, and Eliasaph must lead their army.
kn2w
Who must set out second from the camp?
The whole camp of Reuben, with the two tribes that set up their tents near Reuben tribe, must set out second.
pp17
Where will the tent of meeting and the camp of the Levites be when they set out?
They will be in the midst of the camps.
Where must the 40,500 men of the tribe of Ephraim camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp near the banner of Ephraim on the west side of the tent of meeting, and Elishama must lead their army.
hs5p
Where must the 32,200 men of the tribe of Manasseh camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp next to Ephraim, and Gamaliel must lead their army.
hxvg
Where must the 35,400 men of the tribe of Benjamin camp, and who must lead their army?
They must also camp next to Ephraim, and Abidan must lead their army.
o3ci
How many men are counted in the camp of Ephraim?
The camp of Ephraim has 108,100 men.
kevw
When must the camp of Ephraim set out in relation to the other camps?
The camp of Ephraim must set out third.
Who leads the tribe of Dan?
Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai leads the tribe of Dan.
qbr0
How many men are counted in the army of the tribe of Dan?
The army of the tribe of Dan has 62,700 men.
f3jd
Where must the 41,500 men of the tribe of Asher camp, and who must lead their army?
They must camp next to Dan, and Pagiel must lead their army.
o31v
Where must the 53,400 men of the tribe of Naphtali camp, and who must lead their army?
They must also camp next to Dan, and Ahira must lead their army.
yogj
Who must set out last from the camp?
The whole camp of Dan, with the two tribes that set up their tents near Dan tribe, must set out last, and the men there number 157,600.
mxsr
Whom did Moses and Aaron not count among the people of Israel, and why?
They did not count the Levites among the people of Israel because Yahweh had commanded Moses not to count them.
gjd5
What did the people of Israel do?
The people of Israel did everything that Yahweh commanded Moses. They camped by their banners, and they set out by their clans and their ancestral families.
fb25
Whose family history does this passage record?
This passage records the family history of Aaron and Moses.
wzoe
What were the names of Aaron’s sons?
The names of Aaron’s sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
f3eg
What work did the sons of Aaron do, the ones who were anointed?
The sons of Aaron were the priests. They were anointed and set apart to serve as priests.
ejsc
Why did Nadab and Abihu die in front of Yahweh?
Nadab and Abihu died in front of Yahweh when they offered strange fire to him.
c3bc
Which of Aaron’s sons served as priests with Aaron?
Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron.
ytdc
Which tribe did Yahweh say was to help Aaron serve as priest?
The tribe of Levi was to help Aaron.
wriz
What were the duties of the tribe of Levi?
They were to do the work for Aaron and for all the Israelites at the tent of meeting, take care of all the equipment of the tent of meeting, and serve at the Dwelling.
x9fc
Whom did Yahweh tell Moses to give to Aaron and his sons?
Yahweh told Moses to give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. The Levites were given to Aaron from among the Israelites.
hzoc
Whom did Yahweh set apart for himself?
Yahweh took the Levites for himself instead of the firstborn of Israel. He also set apart for himself every firstborn in Israel, both people and animals.
enld
When did Yahweh set apart all the firstborn of Israel for himself?
He set apart for himself all the firstborn in Israel on the day that he struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
mqrr
Where did Yahweh speak to Moses when he told him to count the sons of Levi?
Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai.
f4m1
Whom did Yahweh command Moses to count in the tribe of Levi?
Yahweh commanded Moses to count every male in Levi who was one month old or older.
rjvd
Who were the sons of Levi?
The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
nl51
Who were the sons of Gershon?
The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei.
ybve
Who were the sons of Kohath?
The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
zw42
Who were the sons of Merari?
The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi.
svn0
Which two clans came from Gershon?
The clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites came from Gershon.
hspy
How many Gershonite males who were one month old or older did Moses count?
Moses counted 7,500 Gershonite males who were one month old or older.
wfk3
Where were the clans of the Gershonites to camp?
The clans of the Gershonites were to camp behind the Dwelling, on the west side.
fxpt
Who was the leader of the ancestral family of the Gershonites?
Eliasaph the son of Lael was the leader of the ancestral family of the Gershonites.
f2vy
Who was to take care of the Dwelling, the tent and its covering, the curtains, the hangings of the courtyard, and the ropes?
The sons of Gershon were to take care of the Dwelling, the tent and its covering, the curtains, the hangings of the courtyard, and the ropes.
ezcd
Which four clans came from Kohath?
The clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites came from Kohath.
jbwr
How many Kohathite males who were one month old or older did Moses count? What did they do?
Moses counted 8,600 Kohathite males who were one month old or older. They were the keepers of the holy place.
jkp0
Where were the clans of the sons of Kohath to camp?
The clans of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the Dwelling.
vdxa
Who was the leader of the ancestral family of the clans of the Kohathites?
Elizaphan the son of Uzziel was the leader of the ancestral family of the clans of the Kohathites.
bpwh
What were the clans of Kohath, who camped on the south side of the Dwelling, to take care of?
They were to take care of the box, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the vessels of the holy place, and the curtain.
f6be
Who was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest to supervise?
He was to supervise the leaders of the Levites and the men who took care of the holy place.
t0mv
Which two clans came from Merari?
The clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites came from Merari.
bv4b
How many Merarite males who were one month old or older did Moses count?
Moses counted 6,200 Merarite males who were one month old or older.
gwhd
Who was to lead the clans of Merari, who camped on the north side of the Dwelling?
Zuriel the son of Abihail was to lead the clans of Merari.
wp1u
What were the clans of Merari, who camped on the north side of the Dwelling, to take care of?
They were to take care of the frames of the Dwelling, its crossbars, pillars, bases, and all its vessels, and the pillars, bases, pegs, and ropes of the courtyard.
b2cr
What were Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons, who camped on the east side of the Dwelling, to do?
They were to take care of the holy place and to do the duties that belonged to the Israelites.
twyw
What was to happen to anyone who was not a Levite and who came near the holy place?
That person was to be put to death.
rl5g
Whom did Moses and Aaron count?
Moses and Aaron counted every male of the Levites who was one month old or older. The total was 22,000.
b08b
Whom did Yahweh tell Moses to count among the sons of Israel?
Yahweh told Moses to count every firstborn male of the sons of Israel who was one month old or older.
d7u7
Whom did Yahweh tell Moses to take for him instead of the firstborn of Israel and instead of their animals?
Yahweh told Moses to take the Levites and the animals of the Levites instead of the firstborn of Israel and their animals.
z8cw
Then whom did Moses count?
Moses counted all the firstborn males of Israel by name, who were one month old or older. The total was 22,273.
u3af
To whom did all the Levites belong?
The Levites belonged to Yahweh.
g8tn
How much silver did Yahweh tell Moses to take for each of the 273 firstborn males who were more than the number of the Levites?
Yahweh told Moses to take five shekels for each one. He was to use the shekel of the holy place.
m0o8
To whom did Yahweh tell Moses to give the silver for the ransoms?
Yahweh told Moses to give the silver to Aaron and his sons.
bk43
From whom did Moses take the silver of the ransom?
Moses took the silver from the firstborn who were more than the number of the Levites.
hrl2
How much silver did Moses take from the firstborn of the sons of Israel?
Moses took 1,365 shekels of silver, by the shekel of the holy place.
utfo
To whom did Moses give the silver for the ransom of the firstborn of Israel?
He gave the silver to Aaron and his sons, as Yahweh had commanded.
ln54
What were Moses and Aaron to conduct?
Moses and Aaron were to conduct a census of the male descendants of Kohath from among the Levites who were 30 to 50 years old.
oyv8
What were the descendants of Kohath to do to serve in the tent of meeting?
They were to take care of the most holy things in the tent of meeting.
hssn
What were Aaron and his sons to take down when the camp set out?

They were to take down the curtain that blocks off the Most Holy Place and cover the Box of the Testimony with it. Then they were to cover the Box with porpoise skin, spread a completely blue cloth over the skin, and set its poles in place.
o99i
Over what were Aaron and his sons to spread a blue cloth, and what were they to put on the cloth?
They were to spread a blue cloth over the table. Then they were to put the dishes and the palm-sized bowls and the bowls and the pitchers for the drink offering on it.
u5dj
What was always to be on the table?
The bread was always to be on the table.
jalh
What were they to use after that to cover the table and the things on it, and what were they to set in place to carry the table?
They were to spread a scarlet cloth over the table and the things on it and cover that with porpoise skin. Then they were to set the table’s poles in place.
wcuz
How were they to prepare the lampstand and all its equipment for moving?

They were to cover the lampstand, its lamps, its tongs, its trays, and all its oil vessels with a blue cloth. Then they were to put the lampstand and all its equipment into a porpoise skin covering and put them on the carrying pole.
h5a9
How was the gold altar to be prepared for moving?
They were to spread a blue cloth over the gold altar, cover it with porpoise skin, and set its poles in place.
kbov
How was all the equipment for the work in the holy place to be prepared?
They were to take all the equipment for the work in the holy place and put it into a blue cloth. Then they were to cover it with porpoise skin and put it on the carrying pole.
ljgn
What were they to remove from the altar, and what were they to spread over it?
They were to remove the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
rd6v
Where were they to put all the equipment that they used at the altar?
They were to put all the equipment, including the trays, the meat forks, the shovels, and the basins, on the altar.
cvgp
With what were they to cover the altar before they set its poles in place?
They were to cover the altar with porpoise skin before they set its poles in place.
eb9w
Who was to come and carry the holy place and all its equipment after Aaron and his sons finished covering them when the camp set out?
The descendants of Kohath were to come and carry them, but they must not touch the holy place, or they would die.
j0ft
Of what was Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, in charge?

He was in charge of the oil for the light, the incense of spices, the regular grain offering, and the anointing oil. He was also in charge of the whole Dwelling and everything in it, including the holy place and its equipment.
egd8
What were Moses and Aaron not to do to the Kohathite clans, so that the Kohathites would live and not die?
They were not to cause the Kohathite clans to die among the Levites. Aaron and his sons were to assign each man his service and what he must carry.
cx5b
What did Yahweh warn that the Kohathites must not go in to see, or they would die?
They must not go in to see the holy place, even for a moment, or they would die.
przh
Who alone was allowed to go into the holy place?
Only Aaron and his sons were allowed to go into the holy place.
qypx
What did Yahweh tell Moses to do concerning the men of the Gershon clans who would serve in the tent of meeting?
Moses was to count the men of the Gershon clans who were 30 years old to 50 years old.
uylx
What was the work of the Gershonites?

The work of the Gershonites was to carry the curtains of the Dwelling and the tent of meeting, its covering, the porpoise skin covering over it, and the curtain at the entrance of the tent of meeting. They were also to carry the hangings of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard, their ropes, and all the equipment for their service.
k1f2
Who was to direct all the service of the Gershonites, who were under the care of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest?
Aaron and his sons were to direct all the service of the Gershonites.
wh4j
Which men of the Merari clans did Yahweh tell Moses to count?
Moses was to count the men of the Merari clans who were 30 to 50 years old and who came to serve in the tent of meeting.
l9mu
What were the Merari clans to do in their service for the tent of meeting?

They were to carry the frames of the Dwelling, its crossbars, its pillars, and its bases. They were also to carry the pillars of the courtyard with their bases, pegs, and ropes. Moses was to count by name the equipment that each man must carry.
vdo3
Who was in charge of the Merari clans as they served in the tent of meeting?
Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest, was in charge of them.
ebyq
What did Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel do to obey Yahweh?
They counted the Kohathites by their clans and families, all the men who were 30 to 50 years old and who came to serve in the tent of meeting.
ou2p
How many men of the Kohathite clans did Moses and Aaron count?
They counted 2,750 men.
p7vc
How many men of the Gershonite clans did Moses and Aaron count?
They counted 2,630 men.
btky
Who else was counted in their clans from 30 to 50 years old?
The descendants of Gershon were counted in their clans.
tkx4
Who else did Moses and Aaron count in their clans from 30 to 50 years old?
The descendants of Merari were counted in their clans.
s8uy
Who counted the Levites according to their clans and families?
Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel counted them.
When Moses counted each Levite in the clans who was 30 to 50 years old, which men did he count?
He counted every man who came to do the work of service and the work of carrying burdens in the tent of meeting.
k4w1
How many Levites did Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel count in total?
They counted 8,580 men.
kp1k
When Moses counted each man and kept count of each man’s type of work and responsibility, whom did he obey?
When Moses counted each man and kept count of each man’s type of work and responsibility, he obeyed Yahweh.
hptx
Which people, both men and women, did Yahweh say must be sent away from the camp?
Yahweh said to send away everyone who has a skin disease, everyone who has a bodily discharge, and everyone who is unclean because of touching a dead body.
uix1
What did the Israelites do after Yahweh told Moses to send these people away?
The Israelites sent those people outside the camp, just as Yahweh had spoken to Moses.
yaza
What does Yahweh say about a man or a woman who sins against another person?
He says that the person is unfaithful against Yahweh and is guilty.
ppx1
What did Yahweh tell Moses that a man or woman who sins against another person must do?
That person must confess the sin, pay back the full cost of the guilt to the one who was wronged, and add one fifth more.
fu1w
What must the guilty person do with the payment if the wronged person has no close relative to receive it?
The guilty person must give the payment to Yahweh by giving it to the priest, along with a ram for atonement. The priest then owns it.
lxkc
What did Yahweh say a man’s wife might do?
She might turn aside and be unfaithful to her husband.
jkju
What did Yahweh say might be true of the wife even though her husband does not know about it?
She might have lain with another man and become unclean, but there is no witness against her, and she has not been caught.
izy1
What did Yahweh say might come over the husband?
A spirit of jealousy might come over him, and he would be jealous of his wife, whether she is unclean or not.
oj0n
What did Yahweh say a man must do with his wife if he is jealous and thinks she has sinned against him?

The man must bring his wife to the priest with an offering of about two liters of barley flour. He must not put oil or frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy that causes sin to be remembered.
v1pl
What does the priest do first?
The priest places the woman before Yahweh. Then he takes holy water in a clay jar and mixes dust from the floor of the Dwelling into the water.
rrp5
Then what does the priest do?

The priest lets the woman’s hair down and puts the grain offering of jealousy in her hands. While the priest holds the bitter water that brings a curse, he makes the woman swear an oath. He tells her that if she has not been unfaithful to her husband, the water will not harm her.
hewk
What did the priest tell the woman would happen among her people if she was unfaithful to her husband?
The priest told her that Yahweh would make her a curse among her people by making her abdomen swell and her thigh waste away.
wj9x
What does the water that brings a curse cause if the woman is guilty?
The water causes her abdomen to swell and her thigh to waste away.
ubib
What does the priest do with the curses that he writes in the book?
He wipes the curses off into the bitter water.
xn76
What must the priest do with the bitter water that has the curses in it?
The priest must make the woman drink the bitter water.
dj4a
What does the priest do with the grain offering?
The priest takes the grain offering from the woman’s hand, holds it up to Yahweh, and brings it to the altar. He burns a handful of it, the memorial portion, on the altar.
xnk9
What does the priest do with the bitter water after he burns the memorial portion?
He makes the woman drink the bitter water.
vlp8
What happens to the woman if she has been unfaithful to her husband?
Her abdomen swells, her thigh wastes away, and she becomes a curse among her people.
nn4s
What will happen to the woman if she has not been made unclean?
She will be free and will be able to conceive children.
g2p8
What is the law of jealousy?
It is the law for a woman who turns away from her husband and becomes unclean. It is also the law for a man who has a spirit of jealousy and is jealous of his wife.
ux3o
What does Yahweh say about the husband and the wife after the priest does all this law?
The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman who has done wrong will bear the consequences of her sin.
qmkv
Who separated himself unto Yahweh with the vow of a Nazirite?
A man or woman gave a vow of a Nazirite to separate himself to Yahweh.
ytrt
What did a person who had made the vow of the Nazirite not eat during the days of his separation to Yahweh?
He did not eat wine, strong drink, vinegar, grape juice, grapes, and raisins—any thing that had grapes in it.
lmip
What did he not use during the days of his separation?
During the days of his separation he did not use a razor on his head.
nf7v
During the days of his separation to Yahweh, to what must the one who takes a Nazirite vow not come near?
One who takes a Nazirite vow must not come near a dead body.
ae22
To whom was he reserved during the days he was separated and holy?
During the time of his separation he was holy, reserved for Yahweh.
tvcs
What did a Nazirite do seven days after he was defiled by a dead body?
After seven days a Nazirite shaved his head.
rsxu
On the eighth day, what did a defiled Nazirite first need to bring for an atonement to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting when he consecrated himself?
On the eighth day he needed to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting for an atonement. Then he had to consecrate himself on that same day.
mu9g
For what were the two offerings?
The two offerings were as a sin offering and a burnt offering for atonement.
kt0v
What guilt offering did he have bring to rededicate himself to Yahweh for the time of his separation?
To rededicate himself to Yahweh for the time of his separation, he had to bring a male lamb one year old as a guilt offering.
aun9
What sin offering did the defiled Nazirite need to bring to the entrance of the tent of meeting with his male lamb for a guilt offering?

He needed to bring a sin offering of a female one year old lamb without blemish, a ram without blemish as a fellowship offering, a basket of bread without leaven, a grain offering, and a drink offering to Yahweh.
jmci
Who had to present the offerings to Yahweh for the Nazirite?
The priest had to present them before Yahweh.
an28
What did the Nazirite have to do with the hair that he shaved from his head?
He had to take the hair and put it on the fire under the fellowship offerings.
